description: A residential backyard patio at evening twilight, with a lush rectangular in-ground pool shimmering in electric blue in the background and a mature tree line visible against the darkening blue-grey sky. The patio surface is large-format natural stone pavers in a warm cream tone. On the right side of the frame, a compact outdoor sofa in light greige fabric sits on the patio, dressed with fringe-trim throw cushions in ivory and warm white, exuding a relaxed coastal-casual appeal. To the left, a large two-toned ceramic planter — ribbed dark grey at the base, cream at the top — holds a full lavender plant in bloom, its purple spikes adding a delicate floral accent. The lawn beyond the patio is lush and dark green in the low evening light. A wooden privacy fence runs along the far property edge. Warm glowing amber light pools downward and outward across the patio stone from a source positioned between the sofa and the planter, creating a warm halo on the paver surface at dusk. The atmosphere is warm, still, and summery — a perfect private backyard moment at the transition from day to evening. Camera is at low-to-standing eye-level, three-quarter composition centering the vignette with the pool visible in the background. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
